**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**Strategic Focus

* Provide accurate and reliable data, analysis, and reporting to support informed prioritisation, planning, and delivery decisions by business leaders and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO processes, tools, dashboards, workflows, reporting capabilities, and overall stakeholder experience.
Operational Management
* Manage assigned Work Requests (WRs) throughout the full lifecycle, including intake, triage, high\-level estimation (HLE), quote management, approvals, scheduling readiness, actuals processing, and closure activities.
* Triage new Work Requests, validate mandatory information and project codes, route requests to the appropriate estimation or delivery stream, and prepare weekly governance and prioritisation meeting agendas.
* Coordinate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to obtain high\-level estimates and support the completion of E\-Quotes within agreed service level timelines.
* Proactively track quote approvals, update workflow statuses upon approval, confirm scheduling readiness, and facilitate a comprehensive handover to the relevant Release Manager.
* Process actuals for applicable Fee\-for\-Service engagements, coordinate reviews, and support the timely closure of Work Requests.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date JIRA dashboards, workflow statuses, Fix Versions, project codes, and mandatory data fields as the authoritative source of operational information.
* Monitor ageing requests and backlog items, revalidate stalled requests with requestors, and escalate risks, delays, issues, or unresolved dependencies as required.
* Consolidate, review, and quality\-assure weekly programme and portfolio status reports, ensuring clear visibility of progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and key actions.
* Maintain RAID logs, benefits registers, action logs, project plans, and other PMO artefacts, ensuring records remain accurate, complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Coordinate governance forums, meetings, and workshops; prepare and distribute meeting materials, document decisions, actions, risks, issues, and dependencies, and track them through to closure.
* Maintain PMO documentation and knowledge repositories within SharePoint and other PMO platforms, including document management, archiving, and onboarding support.
* Serve as the first point of contact for PMO\-related process, workflow, reporting, governance, and system queries.
People Leadership
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Release Managers, SMEs, business owners, Finance teams, and other key stakeholders.
* Drive successful outcomes through proactive communication, clear accountability, and disciplined follow\-up, while appropriately escalating issues requiring decisions, support, or intervention.
* Provide guidance on PMO processes, JIRA data standards, project code management, and governance requirements to enhance team capability and compliance.
* Support the onboarding of new team members and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and customer\-focused PMO culture.
Governance \& Risk
* Ensure compliance with approved governance processes, documentation standards, financial controls, and audit requirements.
* Validate that Work Requests (WRs) are assigned the correct project codes and include all required supporting documentation, references, and approvals, particularly for risk\-related and high\-value initiatives.
* Escalate high\-cost or high\-effort requests in accordance with established governance thresholds and ensure all mandatory approvals are obtained and documented.
* Proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and control gaps, taking appropriate action to resolve them or escalating them promptly to the PMO Manager and relevant stakeholders as required.
* Support programme and project health checks, maintaining appropriate evidence and documentation to demonstrate compliance, governance adherence, and decision traceability.
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time\-to\-time based on business needs.  

  

**Experience \& Personal Attributes**Experience
* Experience working within a PMO, Programme Office, Project Office, programme support, project administration, or a similar structured project delivery environment.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating project and programme governance activities, status reporting, meetings, action tracking, and document management.

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Overview  

Foundational Data \& Model Services sits in Data \& AI Foundations, inside Business \& Market Insights. We own the data that B\&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.  

  

About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on\-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load\-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.  

  

The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.  

  

Role  

You will own the delivery plan across the squads doing this work, and manage the dependencies between them, the platform teams we rely on, and the product teams waiting on us. Specifically, you will:  

  

Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.  

Run the migration off Hadoop and on\-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.  

Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.  

Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.  

Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.  

Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade\-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.  

Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.  

  

All about you  

We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.  

  

Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.  

Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.  

Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.  

Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.  

Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.  

A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow\-through rather than mandate.  

Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
